_comment: Bowman KB Agent draft, run 41 (Tue Nov 24 2026), from classes/BOW12-staging.md (stage 1, run 39) + priors (stage 2, this run). NOT complete - universeComplete false. 2012 is a logo year (README #1); the class rule is the first Bowman-family Chrome prospect auto by checklist history, logo as evidence (R9.7).
note: Derivation: every hobby Chrome prospect autograph of 2012 Bowman (May, 'Bowman Chrome Prospect Autographs', 38, BCP numbers [HIGH: Cardboard Connection + Sports Collectors Digest]), 2012 Bowman Chrome (fall, 'Prospect Autographs', 41, BCA- [HIGH: CC x2 + baseballcardpedia]) and 2012 Bowman Draft Picks & Prospects ('Chrome Draft Picks Autographs', 40, BCA- [HIGH: baseballcardpedia + CC x2]) = 119 rows, no player twice. Priors: all 119 names searched across the nine 2009-2011 Chrome prospect/draft auto lists on baseballcardpedia (2009 Bowman 17, 2009 Chrome 24, 2009 BDPP 22, 2010 Bowman 31, 2010 Chrome 41, 2010 BDPP 32, 2011 Bowman 34, 2011 Chrome 37, 2011 BDPP 34 BCAP-), cross-checked on Cardboard Connection where it has a list (2009 Bowman, 2009 BDPP, 2010 Bowman, 2010 three-product rankings, 2011 Bowman, 2011 Chrome autographs) - read Nov 24 2026. One hit: Scooter Gennett 2010 Bowman Chrome BCP206 -> BCA-SG false. Team USA / USA 16U-18U / wrapper-redemption USA Chrome autos (Almora, Maples, Delmonico, Seager, Sims, Cecchini, Russell, Brad Miller, Brian Johnson, Cole, Bradley Jr., Fontana) are insert autos, not priors, as in BOW13 (08 §1; the counting question is G61 for Mo). Not Bowman-family priors: 2010-11 Bowman Platinum / Sterling autos (Skaggs BPA-TS, Singleton BPA-JS2, Team USA relic/dual autos). Excluded by the 08 §1 working rule: 2012 Bowman retail BPA- (20, paper), paper Darvish #209, Chrome Rookie Autographs (RA- Harper, Bauer, Middlebrooks, Darvish), Bowman Black BBC-, FAD-, FGAP-, LIM-, TPA- duals, AFLAC / Perfect Game / Under Armour. Code collisions fall Chrome vs Draft: BCA-BM, JG, JR, MH, MS, RS (G28) - key is player + product + code. Open before universeComplete: (1) SportsCardsPro console slugs for the three products not read; (2) 2012 Mega / retail-exclusive Chrome auto sets not read; (3) 2012 May list single-source for names (CC; SCD for count); (4) teams not carried (not required).
